Web Circulation 
 
 
  
 
 
No.  C-II/Misc./02/06/Ex./EZ/Vol.I                                             Date: 12.09.2016 
 
 
To  
 
All Regional Provident Fund Commissioners 
 
In-Charge of Regional/Sub Regional Offices. 
 
 
 
Subject : Transfer of Past Accumulation on cancellation of exemption – 
instructions thereof – regarding. 
 
 
Sir, 
 
Instances have come to the notice of Head Office that the Regional Provident Fund 
Commissioners, In-Charge of Regional/Sub Regional Offices do not take action in time to get 
the Past Accumulation of the members transferred from the Trust to EPFO on cancellation of 
exemption by the appropriate government to protect the interest of the members.   
 
2. 
A number of complaints are received at Head Office from the members, trade unions, 
etc. regarding non-disbursal of claims from such provident fund accumulations.  At times, the 
establishments approach the EPFAT and High Courts and obtain stay against cancellation of 
exemption granted to them.  This delays the transfer of Past Accumulation and thus puts the 
hard-earned  money of the workers in suspense which jeopardize their interest.  The Central 
Provident Fund Commissioner, while reviewing the status of the exempted establishments, 
expressed his concern and  directed to call  for the details of cases where transfer of past 
accumulation is yet to be effected pursuant to cancellation of exemption.  
 
3. 
All  the Regional Provident Fund Commissioners, In-Charge of Regional/Sub 
Regional Offices are, thus, directed to transmit the information with regard to 
transfer of past accumulation on cancellation of exemption in the .xls format 
attached herewith by 30.09.2016 and thereafter on monthly basis through e-mail at 
rc.exemption@epfindia.gov.in . 
 
 
Tele :  011-26175914 
 Fax   : 011-26177827 
E-mail : acc.hq@epfindia.gov.in

4. Further, it has been noted that the Regional Provident Fund Commissioners, In-
Charge of Regional/Sub Regional Offices are not timely forwarding the proposals to Head
Office for cancellation of exemption due. to violations of the conditions stipulated in
Appendix-A to Paragraph 27AA of the Employees’ Provident Funds Scheme, 1952 by the
exempted establishments. They are directed to forward such cases to Head office well in
time.

Enclosures : As above.
(This issues with the approval of CPFC.)

Yours faithfully,

—44 | aul
(P.K. Udgata)
Additional Central P.F. Commissioner (HQ)

Copy to : All Additional Central Provident Fund Commissioners(Zones) with a request to
see that the instructions are carried out by the Regional/Sub Regional offices
under their jurisdiction in letter and spirit.
